BR-UK Statement

Using AI for Behavioural Research Effectively and Responsibly

BR-UK is developing a living statement addressing ethical standards, practical benefits and limitations, and recommendations for people doing, using, funding, or commissioning behavioural research. It is informed by AI-assisted evidence review, expert consultation and community engagement.

We are currently conducting consultations with the wider behavioural research community to gather feedback on a draft of the statement before publication.

The first version will be published on Wellcome Open Research later this year.

  • View the draft for consultation on the Open Science Framework
  • Watch the consultation session (YouTube, with adverts)
  • Watch the consultation session (Media Hopper, no adverts)
